method: Primary documentation and public source inspection. No new native-runtime conformance runs. Presence is documented or declared, not proof that a particular installed version emits or enforces it.
scope: Coding clients, hosted variants, agent SDKs, adjacent protocols and discovery gaps. Named surfaces only; not an exhaustive census of private or unindexed products.

semantics.inventory_status: documented_catalog = enumerated public hook API; source_declared = source interface/enum; partial = selected seams; conflicted = primary documents disagree; discovery_only = no usable event contract established.
semantics.controls: Capabilities of the named event only. Empty controls means unmeasured, not observe-only. A capability may require configuration or a specific runtime. See limitations. wake denotes event-triggered activation of an idle session, not an unrestricted external submission API.
semantics.phases: Proposed semantic classification, not current UnifiedPhase literals or native event names. Around callbacks retain their wrapper semantics.
semantics.registration: Disambiguates exact native names scoped to different callback APIs or event buses.
semantics.verification: All entries need version-pinned native conformance before enforcement certification.
semantics.absence: An omitted hook/capability is not evidence of absence. Unsupported is asserted only in explicit limitations.

surfaces.label: Claude Code
surfaces.scope: Current reference; CLI/SDK differences retained

contract.configuration: Settings at user, project, local and managed scopes; plugins.
contract.handlers: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt, agent; event restrictions apply.
contract.payload: Session/cwd/event plus event-specific tool, task, path or batch fields.
contract.dispatch: Synchronous and asynchronous; asyncRewake can wake an idle session.
contract.failure: Phase-specific; exit 2 is not a universal veto.

limitations: FileChanged detects completed writes; no writer identity or rollback. Literal path matching; watchPaths replacements accepted only at SessionStart, CwdChanged and FileChanged.
PostToolBatch precedes a model request, not necessarily the end of a user turn.
ConfigChange gates runtime application, not disk writes; managed policy exceptions exist.
PreToolUse defer is restricted to the noninteractive SDK path.

surfaces.label: Codex CLI
surfaces.scope: Current official reference; installed CLI previously identified as 0.153.4

contract.configuration: Reviewed hook definitions; project/user and managed scopes.
contract.handlers: command and mcp_tool; prompt/agent definitions are parsed but skipped.
contract.payload: Claude-shaped envelopes; native event identity must retain the Codex client.
contract.dispatch: Async feedback needs a safe active boundary or subsequent user turn; session shutdown cancels pending work.
contract.failure: PreToolUse ask is unsupported and fails open as a hook error; reserved permission fields fail closed.

limitations: No documented FileChanged, watchPaths, ConfigChange, PostToolBatch or idle async wake.
PostToolUse also covers failed shell calls. Code-mode block can reject a nested promise; continue:false has different behavior.
All twelve names are registered locally; this does not establish semantic parity.

surfaces.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
surfaces.scope: Current CLI reference

contract.configuration: Project .github/hooks/*.json, user ~/.copilot/hooks/*.json, settings, plugins and policy.
contract.handlers: command and HTTP; sessionStart also accepts prompt entries.
contract.payload: camelCase versus PascalCase aliases select different input schemas and matching conventions.
contract.dispatch: Configured hooks run in order; notification context can activate an idle session.
contract.failure: Pre-tool command failure can deny; timeouts always fail open. HTTP errors fail open.

limitations: Current docs supersede the old deny-only, repository-only description.
userPromptTransformed rewrites content before persistence but cannot veto submission.
Config-file userPromptSubmitted output is discarded; modifiedPrompt belongs to SDK callbacks. Built-in general-purpose subagents omit subagent lifecycle hooks.
Stop continuation is bounded. Subagent response rewrites do not compose: the last rewrite wins.

surfaces.label: GitHub Copilot cloud agent
surfaces.scope: Hosted restrictions in the shared hooks reference

contract.configuration: Repository hook definitions in the hosted job.
contract.handlers: See shared reference and hosted restrictions.
contract.payload: Shared hook family with job-specific lifecycle.
contract.dispatch: Session lifecycle once per job; prompt once; compaction automatic only.
contract.failure: PreToolUse ask becomes deny; shared timeout caveat remains.

limitations: notification unsupported. permissionRequest has no hosted permission UI and does not provide an effective gate.
Stop continuation is constrained by the hosted job timeout.
Config-file userPromptSubmitted output is discarded; modifiedPrompt belongs to SDK callbacks. Built-in general-purpose subagents omit subagent lifecycle hooks.

surfaces.label: VS Code Copilot hooks
surfaces.scope: Documented preview; distinct from Copilot CLI and cloud

contract.configuration: Workspace/user hooks, Claude settings, agent frontmatter and plugins.
contract.payload: Claude-style event-specific JSON.
contract.dispatch: SessionStart on first prompt, not necessarily process startup.
contract.failure: Exit 2 has event-specific blocking meaning; other nonzero exits warn.

Agent Host versus extension-host deployment needs a separate runtime probe.

surfaces.label: Gemini CLI

surfaces.scope: Current IDE hooks reference

SessionStart continue:false is not a session veto. Post-tool result rewriting is scoped, including MCP results.

surfaces.scope: Current Cascade hooks page

contract.payload: agent_action_name, trajectory_id, execution_id, timestamp and tool_info.
contract.dispatch: Post-response observers are asynchronous.
contract.failure: Exit 2 blocks pre events; other nonzero exits do not.

These file hooks describe Cascade operations, not arbitrary foreign-process writes.
